2116228872887001308.en_summary: The Nasdaq 100 $QQQ is just a couple ticks away from correction territory. It's down 9.55% from its high just a few weeks ago. Would be its 3rd 10%+ correction of the year. The two prior ones ended at around 11.5%.
2116228872887001308.zh_summary: 納斯達克 100 $QQQ 距離回調區域僅差幾個點。它較幾週前的高點下跌 9.55%。這將是今年第三次 10% 以上的回調。前兩次結束時約在 11.5%。

ticker_notes.QQQ: 較高點下跌 9.55%，接近技術性回調，可能是今年第三次 10%+ 回調

2116228671463964679.en_summary: $AMZN CEO: Amazon's advertising slowdown largely reflects Prime Day timing rather than deterioration in underlying advertising demand. "For advertising, that was 850 basis points sequential impact to Q3 year-over-year growth. Second, Q2 2026 included the first season of NBA on Prime, which last year's Q2 didn't have, while Q3 does not include any NBA. It starts in Q4."
2116228671463964679.zh_summary: $AMZN 首席執行官：亞馬遜廣告放緩主要反映 Prime Day 時間安排，而非基礎廣告需求惡化。「對於廣告，這對第三季度同比增長有 850 個基點的連續影響。第二，2026 年第二季度包括 Prime 上的第一個 NBA 賽季，而去年第二季度沒有，而第三季度不包括任何 NBA。它從第四季度開始。」

ticker_notes.AMZN: 廣告放緩主要因 Prime Day 時間，而非需求惡化；850 基點連續影響

2116228641763835923.en_summary: The gap is nearly gone. On Oct. 23, $WCLD Optix was 89.33 vs. 30.72 for $QQQ. By Oct. 29, WCLD had dropped to 40.44, while QQQ was at 33.11. Nearly all of that came from cloud sentiment falling, not Nasdaq sentiment improving.
2116228641763835923.zh_summary: 差距幾乎消失。10 月 23 日，$WCLD Optix 為 89.33，而 $QQQ 為 30.72。到 10 月 29 日，WCLD 已降至 40.44，而 QQQ 為 33.11。幾乎所有變化都來自雲端情緒下降，而非納斯達克情緒改善。
